svg.title: The tools on my desk
svg.desc: A working toolkit, not an expertise ranking. Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, PHP, Python, Java, Dart. Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap. Backend: Node.js, Laravel, Spring Boot. Data and cloud: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Firebase, Vercel. Tools: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Postman, Vite. Creative tools: Figma, Blender, Canva.
